thread:
maria: Morning — quick check: v2 deprecation email goes out next Wed. Are all SDK owners green on compatibility shims? Need blockers.

jonathan: synced with mobile SDK yesterday. iOS ok, Android has one breaking enum. @kevin can you confirm timeline for enum alias?

kevin: working on patch, PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-android/pull/342. target merge tomorrow EOD. Need one more review from @sasha.

sasha: will review in morning. main concern: runtime will map old enum -> new string in v2 handler to avoid forced client bump.

tess: backend side: can add compatibility header to route to legacy handler for 2 weeks post-deploy. we need feature flag name.

maria: flag: api.v2.compat_fallback. Can eng-platform own rollout gate? @jonathan @sam

jonathan: eng-platform can gate in canary -> global. timeline: canary on Monday, global Tue assuming no perf regressions.

sdk-ci-bot: CI report: sdk-android PR #342 checks failed on 1 test (enum-compat), rerunning.

kevin: ack, rerunning now.

sasha: merged PR, CI green. @maria please confirm we still do no-doc-breaking promise for the deprecation email.

maria: yes — update docs to include migration code sample. I'll ping @marketing for email draft. Also owners: @kevin android, @sasha ios, @tess backend, @jonathan eng-platform, @maria PM.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2-compat-handler canary start 2026-03-22T09:00Z.

maria: Thanks — if anyone has more blockers reply in-thread. :thumbsup:
